first_discovered.meaning: Preserved compatibility value; not accepted as discovery or a UTC ledger receipt.

last_updated.meaning: Preserved compatibility value; not accepted as discovery or a UTC ledger receipt.

limitations: Source labels, local receipts and dynamical epochs are different roles; no common UTC time axis is inferred.
Consistency/replay does not authenticate sources, verify clock synchronization or establish scientific readiness.

local_receipts.scope: verified ledger sequence only; earlier local intake may predate this ledger

deprecated_timestamp_fields.first_discovered: Not a trustworthy discovery timestamp; use sourced discovery_date/chronology. Legacy values are retained, not silently reinterpreted.
deprecated_timestamp_fields.last_updated: Use last_ledger_recorded_at for a verified local receipt, not the last scientific observation. Compatibility values remain in chronology.

total_detections_semantics: distinct stored source assertions, not observations or artificial detections
